---
name: Implementation
about: Track execution of a planned feature
labels: implementation
---

## Plan

Link to the plan in `docs/plans/`.

## Checklist

One item per work unit in the plan. Tick an item only when its work is merged, and link the comment holding its
check results.

- [ ] Unit 1: ...

## Check Results

Paste or attach `just test` and `just lint` output for each merged unit as a comment, and link it from the checklist.

## Deviations and Open Findings

Link each comment that records a deviation from the plan or an unresolved review finding.
